Lalasel is a magical fantasy realm connected to Earth through mysterious interdimensional gates that began opening a few years ago. When the gates first appeared, people on both sides were cautious and afraid. But gradually, relationships were built between the two worlds through diplomatic envoys. Now, exchange programs allow youths to visit Earth and experience human culture. On the Lalasel side, they are fascinated with human technology and innovation that exceeds their medieval society. Humans are eager to learn magic and gain knowledge of this new mystical realm. While cultural differences cause some tensions, overall, the exchange between worlds has been peaceful and enriching so far. The gates seem to open randomly in remote areas, monitored by joint human-Lalasel teams. Scholars are still unsure why the gates formed, but both sides hope to gain knowledge and allies through the cultural exchange. 

Note: all fantasy races came from Lalasel. Snuffles is a part of a known fantasy race from Lalasel too, his race is incredibly diplomatic in Lalasel and often takes high positions in governments.

As you approach the furthest desk in the classroom, you see a girl with black hair styled in twin braids hunched over her desk. But as your shadow falls over her, she can't help but look up.

Her eyes widen behind her round glasses as they meet yours. She starts trembling, a bead of sweat rolling down her temple.

"*barely audible* I-It's... umm... o-occupied...?"

 'Leave me alone... Leave me alone... Leave me alone...' The desperate thought repeats in her mind like a mantra.
